Apex Drift

About Apex Drift

Apex Drift is a realistic 3D drift racing game. Throw your car into hairpins, chain long slides and chase the perfect line on three maps: a mountain pass, a neon city and a sunset coast road. Modes and levels: 15 stages (time trials and drift-score runs, including reverse, night and rain versions), a Drift Arena with a 1:30 clock, and a daily challenge with a streak bonus. Earn 1 to 3 stars on every stage. Cars: 6 cars in the garage. Pick paint and rims, and upgrade engine, tyres and brakes with the money you earn. Race your own ghost, choose a drift assist level (Easy, Normal, Pro), and play in 12 languages on desktop or mobile.

How to play

W Up gas S Down brake reverse A D Left Right steer Space handbrake drift R reset car C camera Q E look left right P Esc pause M mute Mobile on-screen buttons or steering wheel HB handbrake optional tilt steering
